Scroll Elements.Name: PopUp.ServerRules.Description
Text: Welcome to <color=#CF432D>{server_name}</color>! Before you start playing, we would like to remind you of our rules.
1. <color=#CF432D>Respect for other players</color>: Please be polite and respectful when interacting with other members of the community.
2. <color=#CF432D>No cheats or exploits</color>: We strictly prohibit the use of any software or methods that give an unfair advantage to players.
3. <color=#CF432D>No insults or threats</color>: Any form of harassment, discrimination, or threats is not tolerated.
4. <color=#CF432D>No profanity</color>: Avoid using harsh language or obscene words in chat.
5. <color=#CF432D>Fair play</color>: Do not grief or kill other players without reason. Cooperation and fair play are encouraged.
6. <color=#CF432D>Non-interference</color>: Do not interfere with the progress of other players to complete their objectives.
7. <color=#CF432D>Privacy</color>: Do not disclose personal information or private details about other members of our community.
8. <color=#CF432D>Advertising of third-party resources is not allowed.</color> Please do not share links to other websites or resources without the permission of the administrators.
9. The administrators have the right to remove any content that does not comply with the rules of this server.
10. In case of any violation of the rules by a player, the administrators have the authority to block their account.
Thank you for your cooperation and enjoy the game!

Scroll Elements.Name: PopUp.ServerCommands.Description
Text: <color=#CF432D>/bgrade wood</color> – sets building grade to wood
<color=#CF432D>/bgrade stone</color> – sets building grade to stone
<color=#CF432D>/bgrade metal</color> – sets building grade to metal
<color=#CF432D>/bgrade hqm</color> – sets building grade to high quality

Scroll Elements.Name: Popup.ServerRules.Intro1
Text: The game is constantly evolving, and it's impossible to cover every scenario in advance. If you encounter a situation that isn't outlined here, please contact the server moderation team for guidance.

Scroll Elements.Name: Popup.ServerRules.Intro2
Text: Many offenses will receive a warning first; however, some warrant immediate bans. Players with a history of rule violations may be banned regardless of how long ago the offense occurred.

Scroll Elements.Name: Popup.ServerRules.Intro3
Text: If you've been banned and would like to appeal, please contact the moderation team through the official support channels.

Scroll Elements.Name: Popup.ServerRules.Hacking.Description1
Text: Hacking is strictly prohibited and will result in an immediate ban.

Scroll Elements.Name: Popup.ServerRules.Hacking.Description2
Text: If you report a player for hacking, provide as much evidence as possible.

Scroll Elements.Name: Popup.ServerRules.BanEvasion.Intro
Text: You are not allowed to play on the server if:

Scroll Elements.Name: Popup.ServerRules.BanEvasion.List
Text: • You have a game ban less than 8 months old.
• You are linked to multiple game bans.
• You have a non-game-related VAC or other game ban less than 6 months old.

Scroll Elements.Name: Popup.ServerRules.BanEvasion.Warning
Text: Players caught circumventing a server ban will have their new account(s) banned unless the original ban is reversed.

Scroll Elements.Name: Popup.ServerRules.Association.Rule1
Text: If a player is banned for any reason, they are not allowed to evade that ban and play on a new account.

Scroll Elements.Name: Popup.ServerRules.Association.Rule2
Text: Associating with banned players may result in a ban for individuals or an entire team depending on the circumstances.

Scroll Elements.Name: Popup.ServerRules.Association.Rule3
Text: Clear proof of helping banned players evade may result in a ban from all servers.
